messages:
Anita P.: Quick sync — CloudForge marketplace lead just came in. Looks like BlueSpan (SI) attached via referral code but Marco already claimed in SFDC. Who should own the pipeline?
Josh L.: Ping @Marco S. — which account is this?
Marco S.: It's acct 72-CloudForge-Prod in SFDC. BlueSpan did the intro but the customer used the Redwood trial; I claimed because they started onboarding with us. Not sure if SI should retain ownership.
Lee K.: FYI the guideline we've historically used: if the SI is the originator (first_contact_tag=SI) they retain ownership unless the customer explicitly requests Redwood to manage. Marketplace leads default to Redwood unless a co-sell/referral flag exists. Need to check tags.
Anita P.: Right — marketplace flow is messy. CloudForge listing created lead_source=marketplace and BlueSpan attached a referral_code. Proposal: 'Marketplace + referral_code => SI owns initial pipeline' unless customer flips.
Josh L.: :thinking_face: I'm concerned about revenue attribution. Suggest we give SI a 30-day ownership window for referral-code marketplace deals, then auto-escalate to Sales if there's no SI engagement.
Devon R.: Operationally doable. We can set SFDC automation to stamp si_ownership_expires = today + 30. Example pseudo update: 
```sql
UPDATE Opportunity SET si_owner = 'BlueSpan', si_ownership_expires = DATE_ADD(TODAY(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
```
That covers the transition.
Marco S.: Sounds good. Also want billing contact confirmation step: if customer wants SI-managed billing/deployment we keep the opp; if they want Redwood-managed, ownership flips immediately.
Anita P.: OK consensus forming. Action items: document the rule, update marketplace copy to surface referral behavior, and add to the SI playbook. @Lee K. add to playbook, @Devon R. queue the SFDC automation ticket.
Lee K.: Will do. Draft playbook language: 'Marketplace referral code → SI initial ownership (30 days) unless customer explicitly opts into Redwood-managed deployment.' I'll add a flow diagram.
Devon R.: I'll create the ticket with acceptance criteria: automation created, metric dashboard 'si_owned_marketplace_leads' added, and a test plan for ownership expiry. ETA: end of week.
partner-bot: Reminder: joint announcement checklist for CloudForge + BlueSpan is scheduled for Monday. Anita to confirm co-sell wording by Friday.
Anita P.: Noted. I'll update comms copy and loop in marketing. Thanks all :pray:
